def id_badge_label(n):
    """Produce the label text printed on a visitor ID badge.

    Every badge in the building uses one fixed format, so keep the
    output uniform no matter how short the number is. n is an int with
    0 <= n <= 9999. Format the badge number so its width never varies:
    the goal is a fixed-width label that lines up neatly in printed
    rosters. Return exactly the string 'ID-<nnnn>' where <nnnn> is n
    padded with leading zeros to exactly 4 digits. That single
    fixed-width form is the only output the badge printer accepts.

    >>> id_badge_label(0)
    'ID-0000'
    >>> id_badge_label(42)
    'ID-0042'
    """
